notes: The trenchcoat. MILESTONES lists the coat as an open reference gap, so this is a decision, not a reading: a desaturated teal from the master palette's cool half (sky #3FA9F5 / sea turquoise #2FD5C8) rather than a tan. A tan coat on a tan box loses the second raccoon entirely at silhouette distance, and the cool mass is also what keeps a car-filled frame off the palette gate's one-hue failure mode.
